title: Claim Schema
description: A claim is a proposed assertion about state that requires validation

proposer.description: ID of the authority or entity proposing the claim

scope.description: What domain or entity this claim applies to

evidence_refs.description: References to events, documents, or other evidence supporting the claim

requested_authority.description: ID of the authority that should review and decide this claim

risk_level.description: Risk level if this claim is incorrectly accepted

created_at.description: Timestamp when the claim was created

expires_at.description: Optional timestamp when the claim expires

priority.description: Priority for review (1-10, higher is more urgent)

dependencies.description: Claim IDs that must be decided before this claim
